label: Sword & Shield
note: MH3U endgame elemental SnS is built on Honed Blade (Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L), Razor Sharp, Element Atk Up (1.2x), and Evasion +1/+2; the 11-slot Honed Blade/Razor Sharp template can gem in Element Atk Up, while a plain Sharpness +1 mix is the budget alternative. Status SnS instead runs Status Atk +2 (1.225x) and Bombardier for slime. Only Honed Blade's always-on components are modeled (sharpness 'best' = Sharpness +1, attackUp 20 = Attack Up L) plus the 1.2x Element Atk Up; Honed Blade as a combined skill, Razor Sharp, Evasion, Status Atk, specific Fire/Water/Thunder/Ice/Dragon Atk +2 (which does not stack with Element Atk Up in 3U), Weakness Exploit (+5 hitzone on 45+), Challenger +2's enraged +25 raw/+20% affinity, Bombardier, and Evade Extender are unmodeled. The shared sharpness table uses MHFU raw multipliers; MH3U uses 1.05 green / 1.20 blue / 1.32 white / 1.44 purple, so absolute scores are not directly comparable across games.
